data.title: IMF Chief Urges Countries to Do More to Curb Debt and Regulate AI
data.description: The head of the International Monetary Fund says countries both rich and poor must take faster action to cut debt and counter growing inequality as their economies weather a triple whammy from the AI boom and shocks from wars in the Middle East and Ukraine
